subject: Recap: Integration call — auth patterns, SDK handoff, embeddings/rerank plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Emma Alvarez <emma@clearledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Integration call — auth patterns, SDK handoff, embeddings/rerank plan

Hi Emma / ClearLedger team —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Pulled notes below from the call.

Key points we heard:
- You want a production-ready integration for chat + structured tool-calling and embeddings-based reranking.
- Primary auth requirement: least-privilege service identity with automatic rotation; procurement asked for audit-friendly rotation and ability to revoke quickly.
- Sandbox devs may want API keys for speed, but production must use short-lived JWTs or OAuth with RBAC.
- You asked for example SDK flows (token exchange + refresh), routing guidance for multi-model setup, and an embeddings/reranker quality baseline.

Immediate asks / owners:
1) Confirm primary auth pattern (service account short-lived JWT vs. OAuth client credentials) — Emma/procurement (clearledger).
2) Redwood to provide: integration playbook (attached), quick demo script for JWT minting via our SDK, and a short sample for prefix routing + reranker config — Ben.
3) Procurement requested SOC2 artifact and key rotation SLAs — Stephanie to share with procurement and loop Legal as needed.

Attachments included: redwood-integration-playbook-v1.pdf (integration checklist + sample code).

Proposed timeline:
- Playbook + demo notes -> Tue 2028-05-23
- Follow-up call to finalize auth flow -> Tue 2028-05-30 (proposed)

If that matches your expectations, Emma, can you confirm procurement contact and preferred auth approach by EOD Monday?

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

From: Emma Alvarez <emma@clearledger.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@clearledger.com
Date: 2028-05-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Integration call — auth patterns, SDK handoff, embeddings/rerank plan

Thanks Stephanie — great summary. A few clarifications: we are leaning toward a service-account short-lived JWT model (minted by our internal token broker) for production. For dev, sandbox API keys are OK. Procurement (procure@clearledger.com) will own the SOC2 artifacts and contract language but asked for explicit rotation windows and an emergency revoke process.

We would like a short example that shows:
- Redwood SDK call that exchanges a signed JWT for an access token
- Minimal example for prefix routing + embeddings rerank config (pseudo-code is fine)

Procurement also asked whether Redwood supports automatic key rotation for service account key pairs (yes/no) and whether revocation is immediate when a key is removed. If you can state those behaviors in plain language in the playbook it will speed review.

Happy to confirm details on Monday. Also proposing Tue 2028-05-30 9am PT for the follow-up call — will that work?

—Emma
Emma Alvarez
Director of Platform Integrations, ClearLedger
emma@clearledger.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Recap / suggested approach for ClearLedger (auth + SDK)

Folks — copying my quick implementation take so we can have concrete content for the playbook: 

(Quoted from Emma)
On Mon, May 21, 2028 at 11:03 AM Emma Alvarez <emma@clearledger.com> wrote:
> we are leaning toward a service-account short-lived JWT model (minted by our internal token broker) for production.

Proposal:
- Primary production pattern: service-account keypair (private key held in ClearLedger KMS/HSM) signs assertion -> Redwood token endpoint validates signature + issues short-lived access token (15m).
- Rotation: recommend rotating service-account keys every 30 days; Redwood will honor revocation instantly via our identity revocation table and will reject tokens signed by revoked keys.
- Dev sandbox: scoped API keys (longer TTL) that map to a sandbox role in Redwood -> easier onboarding for engineers. Keys are logged and can be manually revoked.
- SDK support: provide sample in our SDK that shows JWT assertion construction (Go/Py/TS snippets), token exchange, and automatic refresh + retry logic when token expires.
- Routing: recommend a simple prefix-routing rule (e.g., /api/v1/clearledger/* -> route to gptx-medium for low-latency, rerank post-process using embeddings index namespace: clearledger-v1). We'll include example config block.

Action items for Ben:
- Draft the SDK snippets + token-exchange demo (Ben) — due Tue 2028-05-23 EOD.
- Confirm exact revocation semantics with infra (Marcus) and add language for playbook.

I'll start a rough markdown fragment and attach to the playbook.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Emma / procurement — thanks for the quick reply and alignment. Confirming the follow-up items and owners: 

1) Redwood playbook + SDK snippets (redwood-integration-playbook-v1.pdf attached) — Ben to deliver demo snippets and a short recorded screen share (JWT mint -> exchange). Deadline: Tue 2028-05-23 EOD.
2) ClearLedger to confirm production auth approach (service-account JWT) and provide procurement redlines by Mon 2028-05-22 EOD.
3) Marcus to validate revocation behavior and add exact SLA language for rotation/revocation in the playbook.
4) Karthik to prepare a recommended routing + reranker config (example embedding dimension / index naming) and add a short quality baseline test for reranker (sample prompts + expected metrics).

Meeting scheduled: Tue 2028-05-30 09:00 PT (invite to follow after Emma confirms).
